title: TrustGraph: SHACL-AF Subject-IRI Policy Filter, Bounded Query/Node Caches & Open-Mode Fallback
summary: TrustGraph evaluates fine-grained knowledge graph access policies stored in urn:graph:policy via PolicyFilter. Loaded sh:NodeShape rules are ordered by sh:order (default 99) and evaluated with first-match-wins precedence, where tg-pol:blocks defaults to True and filters triples by blocked subject IRI. When zero policies are loaded, PolicyFilter enters open mode; otherwise it uses bounded TTL/size caches (QUERY_CACHE_TTL=30s/256, SPARQL_CACHE_MAX=64, NODE_CACHE_TTL=60s/1024).
